libs.note:
BH-9286: stop the triage queue re-offering lines that can never become work. qc_drop_closed (bin/lib/rt/shards.sh, block `closed-issue queue drop`, GitHub-issue boards only): one issue-state read per distinct READY-QUEUE key per tick; a closed issue's line and ready row are dropped through bin/queue-line-drop.sh before a shard is offered, an unknown state keeps the line. qc_refusal_note (bin/triage-shard.sh, after the BH-3949 park): N `call-guard repeat` refusals in a row on unchanged queue text (TSH_QUEUE) drop the line and write one warn lane-alert (id queue-refused-

-); counters in state/queue-refused/

/.n. Applied by the lib itself through lib_env_apply queue-closed . Doc: docs/CALL-GUARD.md.

knobs.note: 1 = read each READY-QUEUE key's GitHub issue state once per tick and drop the line of a closed issue before a shard is offered. 0 = no read, every line kept. Code default 1, read as ${QUEUE_CLOSED_DROP:-1}; any value but 0 or 1 falls back to 1.

Consecutive `call-guard repeat` refusals of one key on unchanged queue text before its READY-QUEUE line is dropped and one warn alert is written. Any other shard outcome resets the count. 0 = never drop, nothing counted. Code default 3, read as ${QUEUE_REFUSED_DROP_AFTER:-3}; a non-integer falls back to 3.

Retention of the repeat-refusal counters (state/queue-refused/

/.n): a counter not touched for this long is deleted on the next call. Code default 604800 (7 days, the triage-park recheck window), read as ${QUEUE_REFUSED_KEEP_S:-604800}; a non-integer falls back to 604800.
